title: Google loses fight over record $4.7B EU antitrust fine
summary: Google lost its appeal against a €4.1 billion EU antitrust fine related to Android's market dominance practices, with the European Court of Justice upholding the original penalty for using Android to illegally cement search engine dominance.
problem_solved: This is a news article reporting on regulatory/legal outcomes rather than a technical solution.
why_valuable: It provides insight into the ongoing regulatory scrutiny of big tech companies and the potential legal consequences of anticompetitive business practices.
